## Named-release rerun (#680)

This section reads only the retained named-release outputs. The evidence is
**numerical verification** on the stated manufactured or shared-model inputs.
It establishes no physical validation or global-stability certificate.
Independent delivered review and owner promotion for manuscript use remain open.

```{python}
#| output: asis
import csv as _csv
import json as _json
from pathlib import Path as _Path
_rr = _Path("results/main-8298c602")
_rp = _json.loads((_rr / "provenance.json").read_text())
_rs = _json.loads((_rr / "summary.json").read_text())
def _rt(headers, data):
    print()
    print("| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |")
    print("| " + " | ".join("---" for _ in headers) + " |")
    for row in data:
        print("| " + " | ".join(str(x) for x in row) + " |")
print("Release: `" + _rp["release"] + "`. Wheel SHA-256: `" + _rp["wheel_sha256"] + "`.")
_rt(["Case", "Quantity", "Named release", "Previous retained value", "Criterion"],
    [[r['case'], r['quantity'], r['new_value'], r['previous_value'], r['criterion'] if r['criterion'] is not None else "reported; no separate allowance"] for r in _rs['comparison_rows']])
print("\nCharged-trial portion: **unavailable**. " + _rs['charged_failure'])
print("\n" + _rs['charged_followup'])
```

The complete requests, returned operands, causes and wheel identity stay in
[the retained run](results/main-8298c602/). No start, physical input, method,
option or criterion was adjusted to obtain agreement.

The composition differences have mole-fraction units. Gibbs differences are
scaled by the larger of unity and the absolute reference $G/(RT)$; density
differences are relative to the independent FeOs result. Amount differences
are reported in moles without introducing a separate allowance. The neutral
and FeOs stages run separately from the charged stage and retain their own
successful numerical checks.

## Explicit charged Vapor qualification attempt (#771)

The selected solvent-density-temperature model admits the explicitly declared
water, sodium-cation and chloride-anion Vapor support, including an intensive
charge row on the zero-pinned vapor. The bubble meets the stated absolute
pressure, chemical, charge, normalization, inventory and refinement limits.
The manufactured trace recovery fails its log-fraction limit, so charged Vapor
remains numerically unqualified. The permitted Newton row-equilibration probe
also fails; its change was removed from the runtime.

```{python}
#| output: asis
_q771 = _Path("results/issue-771-partial")
_p771 = _json.loads((_q771 / "bubble.json").read_text())
_b771 = list(_csv.DictReader((_q771 / "bubble.csv").open()))
_t771 = list(_csv.DictReader((_q771 / "trace-fractions.csv").open()))
print("Conditions and basis: " + str(_p771["conditions"]) + ".")
_rt(["Requested row tolerance", "Quantity", "Value", "Unit"],
    [[r["case"], r["quantity"], r["value"], r["unit"]] for r in _b771
     if r["quantity"] in ("P", "water_gap_over_RT", "full_salt_gap_over_RT", "1/relative_charge", "1/ion_log_gap", "pressure_change", "max_endpoint_change")])
_rt(["Newton representation", "Ionic coordinate", "Target fraction", "Returned fraction", "Log error", "Limit"],
    [[r["variant"], r["coordinate"], r["target"], r["returned"], r["log_error"], r["log_error_limit"]]
     for r in _t771 if r["coordinate"] != "0"])
```

The small absolute charge residual does not resolve the vapor-ion ratio.
The trial balance rows mix charge with normalization, leaving the charge
direction numerically unresolved at trace scale even after left row scaling.
At that partial-build revision, a different charge representation required a design decision.
The [retained rows and diagnostics](results/issue-771-partial/) identify the
input hash, loaded libraries, raw coordinates, reconstructed fractions,
supplied-point root failures and failed correction. Tables suffice for these
scalar checks and the failed recovery; a curve would imply an unmeasured trend.

This section records numerical verification attempts for explicit declared
calculations and supplied-point branch evaluation only. It establishes no
charged-vapor discovery, physical vapor validation or relative accuracy of the
real bubble's trace-ion concentrations. Discovery initial candidates and its

### Log charge-balance correction: bubble closure and failed manufactured recovery

The subsequent correction retains normalization and charge as separate trial
balance rows and uses the exact log charge-balance row in the existing Newton
correction and convergence assessment. It closes the literal bubble's relative
vapor charge at both requested tolerances. The manufactured separated-seed
calculation instead reaches a different stationary point with negative
pressure–density slope, and the existing curvature check rejects it. Full
transformed rank and a small charge defect therefore do not establish recovery
of the manufactured Vapor solution. No start, damping budget, tolerance or
solver was changed to avoid this failure.

```{python}
#| output: asis
_l771 = _Path("results/issue-771-log-charge")
_lb771 = list(_csv.DictReader((_l771 / "bubble.csv").open()))
_lt771 = list(_csv.DictReader((_l771 / "trace-fractions.csv").open()))
_ld771 = _json.loads((_l771 / "diagnosis.json").read_text())
_rt(["Requested row tolerance", "Quantity", "Value", "Unit"],
    [[r["case"], r["quantity"], r["value"], r["unit"]] for r in _lb771
     if r["quantity"] in ("P", "water_gap_over_RT", "full_salt_gap_over_RT", "1/relative_charge", "1/x/1", "1/x/2", "pressure_change", "max_endpoint_change")])
_rt(["Ionic coordinate", "Target fraction", "Reconstructed fraction", "Log error", "Limit"],
    [[r[k] for k in ("coordinate", "target", "returned", "log_error", "log_error_limit")]
     for r in _lt771 if r["coordinate"] != "0"])
_rt(["Native diagnostic", "Retained output"], list(_ld771["native_probe"].items()))
```

The [retained correction evidence](results/issue-771-log-charge/) includes
physical rows, classified rows, raw coordinates, endpoint ranks, returned
fractions, chemical gaps and root checks. The derivative probe checks the exact
log-charge Jacobian by finite differences; it does not change runtime
derivatives. The target is evaluated directly only as a diagnostic, never used
as the falsifier's seed. The actual solve retains the original separated seed.

These are numerical verification attempts for explicit declared calculations.
They establish neither charged-vapor discovery nor physical vapor
applicability, and no experimental uncertainty for vapor-ion concentrations
is available. The earlier Liquid manufactured check did not compare recovered
log fractions; this result supplies no broader Liquid trace-ion qualification.
The mandatory recovery failure keeps the capability unqualified. Independent
delivered review, owner allowance approval and manuscript promotion remain open.


### Newton refinement leaves an initially correct vapor root

The initial density and the optimizer endpoint both lie on their own stable
vapor pressure roots. The full numerical Jacobian agrees with centered finite
differences, and the linear correction solves that system to arithmetic
precision. Reclosing the optimizer endpoint with the existing vapor-root
owner before refinement returns the same unstable stationary point. That
unsuccessful probe was removed from runtime. These observations locate the
failure in the nonlinear refinement trajectory; they do not identify a
wrong density-root selector or an inaccurate linear system.



The accepted first damped correction reduces the largest numerical residual
while increasing the normalization error. The existing refinement permits
such intermediate points and ultimately reaches the rejected branch.
At that revision, changing nonlinear step acceptance needed a method decision
beyond the accepted log-charge correction. The subsequent branch-preserving
method and its recovered solution are reported below. The
[branch diagnosis](results/issue-771-log-charge/branch-selection.json) retains
the conditions, source identities, attempted density reclosure and limits.
Scalar tables clarify this failed recovery; a curve would imply an unmeasured
continuous trajectory. This diagnosis supplies no charged-vapor numerical
qualification or physical validation and has not received independent
review or manuscript promotion.

### Scoped branch checks recover the manufactured Vapor solution

The branch-preserving Newton polish recovers the manufactured trace fractions
from the unchanged separated seed. It inspects common-normalized coordinates
at unchanged packing, without charge reconstruction. The first otherwise
merit-admissible proposal leaves the declared Vapor root window; rejecting it
allows the existing damping and recovery to reach the intended solution.
The [retained branch inspections](results/issue-771-log-charge/branch-preserving.csv)
include raw coordinates and rows, normalized composition, declared and anchored
roots, pressure slopes, log-fraction errors and work. Scalar tables expose these
checks directly; a fitted or interpolated curve would add no measured quantity.

```{python}
#| output: asis
_bp771 = list(_csv.DictReader((_l771 / "branch-preserving.csv").open()))
_rt(["Point", "Quantity", "Value", "Unit"],
    [[r[k] for k in ("point", "quantity", "value", "unit")] for r in _bp771
     if r["quantity"] in ("root_displacement", "pressure_slope", "normalization_defect", "charge_residual", "reduced_hessian_equilibrated", "reduced_hessian_band", "h", "numerical_rank", "physical_rank", "log_error/1", "log_error/2", "log_error/3", "iterations", "evaluations", "hessian_calls", "root_calls", "eos_evaluations")])
_a771 = _json.loads((_l771 / "admission.json").read_text())
print(_a771["conditions"])
_rt(["Compiler", "Reaction reference", "EOS evaluations", "Density solves", "Cause"],
    [[stage, r["referenced"], r["eos_evaluations"], r["density_solves"], r["cause"]] for stage in ("before", "after") for r in _a771[stage]])
```

The real bubble and supplied-point calculations skip this inspection. Their
finite physical arrays and work match the pushed log-charge implementation
bit-for-bit at the checked inputs. The owner approved the source allowance on
2026-10-22; [the calculation identities and limits](results/issue-771-log-charge/branch-preserving.json)
retain that authority separately from numerical evidence.

This is numerical verification of explicit declared calculations and the scoped
optimized trial. It adds no charged-vapor discovery and does not validate the
physical vapor applicability, vapor-ion concentrations or their uncertainty.
Independent delivered review and investigator promotion remain pending.

The compiler refuses a free charged Vapor selected as the omitted-charge phase
before preparing reaction or solid references. It retains effective-support
pruning and the internal trial exemption. The preceding tables retain the
manufactured recovery, admission counts, physical inputs and reference basis. This is an admission
check; it supplies no physical reaction model.

referenced declaration and passes after reference preparation moves later.
DipolarPerturbation, IonSuppression and ComponentMixing declaration refusals
also perform zero EOS evaluations and zero density solves. The manufactured
diagnostic is byte-identical to round 3; the real bubble's finite arrays and
work, supplied-point values and trace-curvature operands remain bit-identical.
Supplied-point evaluation retains its declared thermodynamic work and adds no
